top_signals.title: Brazil Funds Rare-Earth Project in Effort to Tap Vast Reserves
top_signals.summary: Viridis Mining and Minerals Ltd. secured Brazilian government funding for a rare-earth project, as the country seeks to tap more of the world’s largest reserves outside China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ledger CTO urges AI bug hunter responsibility, warns against ‘attention farming’
top_signals.summary: Ledger and Trezor said researchers have a responsibility to publish their findings if vendors fail to fix bugs within an agreed disclosure window.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Novartis Sees Avidity Drug Suffer Third Clinical-Trial Setback
top_signals.summary: Novartis saw a treatment for a rare muscle-wasting disease fail a late-stage study, the third clinical-trial setback in a week. The medicine was the centerpiece of Novartis’s $12 billion takeover of Avidity Biosciences and raises questions about the drugmaker’s growth prospects. Fabienne Kinzelmann reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: AI-discovered lung drug reverses aging markers in study
top_signals.summary: An experimental lung disease drug developed using artificial intelligence showed promise in reversing biological signs of aging, pointing to broader potential use of the treatment, according to its developer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Uzbekistan begins government bond-backed stablecoin payment pilot
top_signals.summary: Humo Digital will test HUMO payments with more than 20 merchants under a sandbox jointly overseen by NAPP and Uzbekistan’s central bank.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
